name: ducat-site
description: ducatproject.org — assembles the page in docs/ together with the shared images/ gallery, which lives at the repo root because the README cites it from there.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html style.css app.js mascot.png og.png dist/ && cp -R ../images dist/images && rm -f dist/images/README.md
